Late September 2024 (First) |virtual_item = {{Color|Other|Golden Plushie}} skin for [[Minigunner]] |toy_type = Plushie }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Golden Minigunner Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy. The plushie offers the Level 3 {{Color|Golden}} skin of [[Minigunner]]. Anybody who bought the toy from the in-game Merch Store will receive the {{Color|Other|Golden Plushie}} skin for the [[Minigunner]]. If bought on the [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games store], it will not come with any rewards. The minigun, backpack and mask of the '''Golden Minigunner Plush''' are detachable. It is made out of plush fabric and polypropylene cotton, its size measures 11.4 inches (28.956 cm) tall, 8.3 inches (21.082 cm) wide and 10.2 inches (25.908 cm) long. A tree is planted for every order of the '''Golden Minigunner Plush'''. ==Official Description== *'''Online (Third)''' *:Your favorite minigunner gets a golden upgrade to help dominate your defense strategy as a limited edition plush. The in-game reward is only included with purchases made in Roblox. Items purchased from shop.paradoxum.games do not include an in-game reward. *'''Online (Second)''' *:Your favorite minigunner gets a golden upgrade to help dominate your defense strategy- as a limited edition plush! *'''Online (First)''' *:Your favorite minigunner gets a golden upgrade to help dominate your defense strategy- as a limited edition plush! This plush comes with a FREE in-game golden skin! ==Prices & Stores== Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''Golden Minigunner Plush''' could be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for $34.99. Previously, it had a cost of $29.99. If bought as part of the Golden Minigunner Bundle, which also included the {{Color|Golden}} [[Minigunner]] keychain, it costed $40.48. During the Black Friday 2025 Sale, it had a cost of $29.99. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Showcase}} GoldenMinigunnerPlushShowcase1.png GoldenMinigunnerPlushShowcase2.png GoldenMinigunnerPlushShowcase3.png GoldenMinigunnerPlushShowcase4.png GoldenMinigunnerPlushShowcase5.png GoldenMinigunnerPlushShowcase6.png GoldenMinigunnerPlushShowcase7.png GoldenMinigunnerPlushShowcase8.png GoldenMinigunnerPlushShowcase9.png GoldenMinigunnerPlushShowcase10.png GoldenMinigunnerPlushShowcase11.png GoldenMinigunnerPlushShowcase12.png GoldenMinigunnerPlushShowcase13.png GoldenMinigunnerPlushShowcase14.png GoldenMinigunnerPlushShowcase15.png }} ==Trivia== *This is currently the only tower plush that is not based on the default skin of the tower. {{ToyNavBox}} [[Category:Plushies]]
